name: error-currency-usd
description: An invoice in USD: the pack's thresholds are in euro, so it refuses non-EUR invoices (it.currency-not-eur); the bridge converts prices to EUR first.

sources.title: DPR 26 ottobre 1972, n. 642
sources.citation: Tariffa, parte I, art. 13, comma 1 e nota 2, lett. a); Tabella, art. 6
